findings.evidence:
- Legacy behavior (first parent): `git show 97edb43^:pkg/dxf/importinto/task_executor.go` shows `getOnDupForKVGroup()` returned `engineapi.OnDuplicateKeyRecord` for `external.DataKVGroup` and `getOnDupForIndex()` returned `OnDuplicateKeyRecord` for unique indexes unconditionally (capture-style conflict handling).
- New behavior: DDL task execution now derives `onDup` from task metadata via `m.taskMeta.Plan.GetOnDupKeyMode()` in `pkg/dxf/importinto/task_executor.go:443-447`, and `Plan.GetOnDupKeyMode()` treats empty as error in `pkg/executor/importer/import.go:337-346` (explicitly noting old task metadata has empty).
findings.fix:
Preserve legacy semantics for pre-option task metadata:
- Change `(*Plan).GetOnDupKeyMode()` default for empty to `OnDupKeyModeCapture` (legacy behavior) OR introduce an explicit task-meta/version field and map “missing OnDupKey” -> capture only for legacy tasks.
- Keep new default for newly-created plans by continuing to set `p.OnDupKey = OnDupKeyModeError` in `initDefaultOptions` (already done).
findings.impact: **Compatibility/metadata correctness:** IMPORT INTO disttask metadata generated before this PR won’t contain `Plan.OnDupKey`. After upgrade/resume, those tasks will implicitly switch from legacy “capture conflicts” to “error on conflict”, causing unexpected job failure on duplicate keys (and potentially leaving partially-processed import state requiring manual recovery).
findings.later_fix_evidence: Checked later history up to `upstream/master` (at `f0813a3696`): `git log 97edb43..upstream/master -- pkg/executor/importer/import.go` shows no follow-up changing `GetOnDupKeyMode`, and `upstream/master:pkg/executor/importer/import.go` still returns `OnDupKeyModeError` when empty.
findings.verify:
- Add a regression test that unmarshals legacy `TaskMeta` JSON without `on_dup_key` and asserts the executor path uses capture-mode `onDup` (or at least `Plan.GetOnDupKeyMode()` returns capture for empty).
- (Optional) Simulate an in-flight task upgrade: create a task meta blob from pre-change code, run merge/ingest step selection, and assert it doesn’t fail solely due to missing `OnDupKey`.
findings.what: `Plan.GetOnDupKeyMode()` defaults missing (legacy) task metadata to `error`, which changes conflict handling for IMPORT INTO DXF tasks created before this option existed (legacy capture → now error) when those tasks are resumed after upgrade.

subject: importinto: introduce a param to control conflict resolution (#66701)
summary: Found one High-severity compatibility issue: legacy IMPORT INTO DXF tasks (metadata created before `on_duplicate_key`) will default to `error` on resume due to `GetOnDupKeyMode()` treating empty as error, changing prior capture semantics and potentially breaking in-flight jobs after upgrade. No later fix observed up to `upstream/master`.
